notes: v3.8 — Tracker & Dispatch quality-of-life: a multi-line Description editor, drag-to-resize tracker columns, a single-company time-clock clear in Settings → Data, and a Dispatch timer that pre-fills with your current task. Live 12-hour / 24-hour switching now updates already-shown times instantly, a first-login note confirms your data is always encrypted, and the Audit dismissed-row styling is clearer on dark themes.
